The '''Assault on the Death Star''' was a mission carried out by [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] operatives [[Kyle Katarn]], [[Corwin Shelvay/Legends|Corwin Shelvay]], [[Lumiya|Shira Brie]], and [[Erling Tredway]] aboard the [[Death Star II/Legends|Second Death Star]]. Shelvay devised the operation in order to thwart the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] plans to destroy the Rebel supply base on [[D'rinba IV]] using the battlestation's [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Admiral, I'm taking command of this battlestation in order to destroy D'rinba IV. Inform me, Admiral, when we are in superlaser range.|Darth Vader|<ref name="IVBG" />}}
Sometime after a failed mission by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] to destroy the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Death Star II/Legends|Second Death Star]],<ref name="manual" /> [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] ordered that the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] be relocated<ref name="IVBG" /> to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]]<ref name="TEAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]], near the [[Endor/Legends|forest moon]] of [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]], so that it could be completed in secrecy.<ref name="IVBG" />

En route from the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]],<ref name="enroute">The ''[[Star Wars: The Interactive Video Board Game]]'' [http://www.hasbro.com/common/instruct/Star_Wars_Assault_on_the_Death_Star_VCR_Board_Game.pdf instructions manual] states that, en route to Endor, Darth Vader discovers Rebel presence in the "nearby" D'rinba system. Given ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''{{'s}} positioning of the D'rinba system within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], it can be deducted that the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]] was traveling outward from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Galactic Core]] at that time.</ref> however, [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] was informed that [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droids]] revealed the existence of a large [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] supply base<ref name="manual" /> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[D'rinba IV]],<ref name="IVBG" /> and notified Emperor Palpatine of the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star's]] temporary diversion to the [[D'rinba system/Legends|D'rinba system]],<ref name="manual" /> within the Mid Rim's [[Sombure sector/Legends|Sombure sector]].<ref name="TEAOC" /> Vader, driven by a hatred for the Rebellion, took two [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] as escorts,<ref name="manual" /> his personal [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']]<ref name="executor">Although the [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] is not mentioned by name in the board game, the game's opening crawl states that Darth Vader's Star Destroyer was present. [[Starships of the Galaxy (Saga Edition)|''Starships of the Galaxy'', Saga Edition]] establishes the ''Executor'' as Vader's personal flagship.</ref> and the [[Colossus (Star Destroyer)|''Colossus'']].<ref name="IVBG" /> The Sith Lord intended to have D'rinba IV close enough to be within the battlestation's [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]] range, so that both the Rebel base and the planet could be completely destroyed.<ref name="IVBG" />

The Rebel Alliance, however, managed to intercept the Empire's plans, and assembled some of their best troops: a small team of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]]<ref name="IVBG" /> and [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] members, with the objective of disabling the Death Star superlaser before it got too close to the planet.<ref name="DFS" /> [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]<ref name="gg9">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref> [[Corwin Shelvay/Legends|Corwin Shelvay]] set up the operation and was joined by fellow operatives [[Lumiya|Shira Brie]], [[Erling Tredway]] and [[Kyle Katarn]].<ref name="DFS" />

==The mission==
[[File:Vader-IVBG.png|thumb|250px|Darth Vader, hailing the Rebel intruders]]
{{Quote|Admiral, we have a small band of Rebels aboard. Alert security.|Darth Vader|<ref name="IVBG" />}}
Aboard a stolen Imperial [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], the operatives infiltrated the space station through the [[Shuttle Bay]], located on the [[Outer Level]]. Shortly thereafter, Darth Vader arrived at the Death Star from the ''Executor'', aboard a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]]. Vader then ordered [[Unidentified Imperial admiral (Death Star II)|the admiral]] in charge of the battlestation to prepare for D'rinba IV's destruction, and soon felt the presence of the Rebel infiltrators. The Sith Lord quickly alerted security, and stationed [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] began to search for the operatives.<ref name="IVBG" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Interactive Video Board Game}}Despite Vader's awareness of the Rebels,<ref name="IVBG" /> Brie, Tredway, Katarn and Shelvay<ref name="DFS" /> soon managed to access the Death Star's [[Inner Level]], and planted six explosives in five control rooms and the station's [[Reactor/Legends|reactor core]]. Meanwhile, Star Destroyer ''Colossus'' reported that the Rebellion was preparing an evacuation from D'rinba IV. The team was able to disable the Death Star's superlaser before it got too close to the planet.<ref name="IVBG" />{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Assault on the Death Star was introduced in ''[[Star Wars: The Interactive Video Board Game]]'', scripted by [[Christian Marnham]] and released in [[1996]].<ref name="IVBG" /> It was later referenced by part one of ''[[The Dark Forces Saga]]'', a series of online adventure scenarios for the [[Wizards of the Coast]] RPG line published on their website. Written by [[Abel G. Peña]], it canonized four of the playable characters as Kyle Katarn, (from ''[[Star Wars: Dark Forces]]''), Shira Brie (from [[Marvel Comics]] [[Star Wars (1977)|''Star Wars'']] series), Corwin Shelvay (from [[West End Games]]' Star Wars RPG material) and Erling Tredway (also from West End Games' Star Wars RPG material), though the outcome of the mission was left ambiguous.<ref name="DFS" />

''The Interactive Video Board Game''{{'s}} opening crawl and its instruction manual both reveal that the Rebel Alliance's goal in the mission was to disable the Death Star, while ''The Dark Forces Saga'' specifically states that the Rebel objective was only to disable the battlestation's superlaser. This article favors the newer source material.
